title: Senior Program Officer - CPHC
description: Overview Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health). About the Program Jhpiego serves as a technical support partner to the State Health Society, Bihar, helping strengthen the implementation of Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC) through Ayushman Arogya Mandirs. Its role includes building the capacity of Community Health Officers and frontline health workers, supporting quality assurance systems, strengthening health service delivery, promoting community engagement, and facilitating the expansion of essential primary healthcare services. Jhpiego also supports the government in developing sustainable health-system processes to improve access, quality, and equity in primary healthcare. About the Position: The Senior Program Officer (SPO) - Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC) will support the implementation, strengthening, and scale-up of CPHC initiatives in Bihar by providing technical and programmatic support to the Health & Wellness Centre (HWC) Cell, State Health Society Bihar (SHSB) . Reporting to the Senior Program Manager (SPM) , the incumbent will work closely with SHSB, district health authorities, Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), and other stakeholders to strengthen service delivery across Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, HWCs, UPHCs, and UHWCs . The role will support effective utilization of the CPHC platform for program monitoring, performance management, and data-driven decision-making. The SPO will also help design and implement Learning Labs across selected geographies to test, document, and scale innovative approaches for primary healthcare strengthening. Additionally, the position will support Social and Behaviour Change Communication (SBCC ) initiatives to improve community engagement, service utilization, and health-seeking behaviors. The incumbent will contribute to program planning, implementation, monitoring, capacity building, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and knowledge management, while supporting innovations and system-strengthening efforts. Responsibilities Provide technical and programmatic support to the Health & Wellness Centre (HWC) Cell, SHSB for planning, implementation, monitoring, and scale-up of Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC) interventions. Support SHSB in strengthening the operational effectiveness of the HWC Cell through process improvements, innovation, capacity building, and evidence-based program management. Assist in developing state strategies, operational plans, guidelines, and implementation frameworks for strengthening CPHC services across Bihar. Support the adoption and effective utilization of the CPHC platform to improve program monitoring, service tracking, performance management, and decision-making at state and district levels. Work closely with government stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging the CPHC platform for improved service delivery, continuity of care, beneficiary tracking, and health system performance. Facilitate the establishment and implementation of Learning Labs in selected geographies to test innovative models, generate implementation evidence, and identify scalable solutions for strengthening primary healthcare systems. Support documentation, evaluation, and dissemination of innovations, best practices, and lessons learned emerging from Learning Labs and CPHC implementation. Coordinate with state and district stakeholders to strengthen implementation of CPHC interventions across Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, HWCs, UPHCs, and UHWCs. Support the introduction and scale-up of innovative approaches, digital solutions, quality improvement initiatives, and operational efficiencies to strengthen the existing HWC ecosystem in Bihar. Collaborate with MERL teams to monitor key indicators, conduct performance reviews, analyze trends, and support data-driven decision-making. Identify implementation bottlenecks and support SHSB in designing and deploying corrective actions and adaptive management strategies. Facilitate capacity-building initiatives, supportive supervision, mentoring, and review mechanisms for government officials and healthcare providers. Organize technical workshops, review meetings, cross-learning forums, and stakeholder consultations to strengthen knowledge sharing and program performance. Support preparation of PIPs, technical proposals, concept notes, policy briefs, presentations, periodic reports, and donor updates. Document project achievements, case studies, innovations, success stories, and evidence for policy advocacy and scale-up. Represent the project in state and district-level technical forums, review meetings, and consultations as required. Undertake travel within Bihar to support implementation, monitoring, coordination, and learning activities. Experience working with government stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams is preferred. Ability to think strategically, handle ambiguity, and problem solve in a fast-paced, limited-structure, multicultural environment Exceptional interpersonal skills, demonstrated ability to build strong professional relationships with a range of stakeholders in a challenging, multi-cultural environment Impeccable written and verbal communication competencies, and fluency in English & Hindi Ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously, set priorities. Ability to be effective in high-pressure situations and work in a fast-paced, limited-structure, multicultural environment. Demonstrated experience in Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC), Health & Wellness Centres (HWCs)/Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, primary healthcare systems strengthening, health systems management, digital health, or public health program implementation. Experience working with State Health Societies, National Health Mission (NHM), HWC Cells, or large-scale government health programs will be preferred. Experience in designing or managing innovation pilots, learning labs, quality improvement initiatives, implementation research, or digital transformation projects in the health sector will be an added advantage. Strong capabilities in and commitment to partnership, co-creation, and respectful engagement with a diverse range of individuals and partners with demonstrated ability to build relationships quickly. Ability to act as a strategic thought partner to, and build the capacity of, government partners and country team members. Proficient computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and data tools like Stata, SPSS, R, Tableau, Power BI, etc. Skills and Competencies: Experience in strengthening health systems, implementation programs, and government stakeholder engagement. Knowledge of urban health, digital health, and CPHC platforms. Ability to design and scale innovations, Learning Labs, and quality improvement initiatives. Experience in Social and Behaviour Change Communication (SBCC), community engagement, and demand generation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in data-driven decision-making. Experience in capacity building, training, mentoring, and supportive supervision. Excellent project management, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, and presentation skills in English and Hindi. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and data analytics/visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SPSS, Stata. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment and manage multiple priorities effectively. title: Senior Program Coordinator - Lab - Pune
description: Overview Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health). About the Program An international non-governmental organization (INGO) is seeking eligible candidates for the position of Senior Program Coordinator based in Pune. The Senior Program Coordinator will be responsible for end-to-end management of laboratory operations for Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) and Acute Diarrheal Disease (ADD) surveillance, ensuring high-quality implementation across patient enrolment support, specimen collection, transport, laboratory processing and testing, reporting, and data management. About the Position The Senior Program Coordinator will provide overall technical and operational leadership to ensure that the laboratory functions uninterrupted, adheres to approved protocols and diagnostic algorithms, meets turnaround time (TAT) expectations, and complies with quality management and biosafety standards. The Senior Program Coordinator will work closely with clinicians, surveillance teams, the designated laboratory, and the IDSP Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU) and Central Surveillance Unit (CSU) teams to strengthen laboratory support for AFI and ADD surveillance and ensure surveillance outputs are timely, complete, and usable for public health action. Responsibilities 1) Laboratory Operations and Technical Oversight Perform specimen processing and testing in alignment with standard protocols and defined diagnostic algorithms. Oversee all project-related laboratory activities, including patient enrolment, specimen collection workflows, transport, receipt, processing, testing, validation, and reporting. Ensure implementation of approved SOPs, diagnostic algorithms, and laboratory workflows for AFI/ADD surveillance. Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of testing and results. Review and validate results prior to reporting, ensuring completeness, consistency, and compliance with protocol requirements. Ensure appropriate specimen storage, referral (if required), and disposal in line with protocols and institutional requirements. 2) Quality Management and Biosafety Compliance Ensure adherence to laboratory quality systems, including internal quality control procedures, documentation, traceability, and corrective action processes. Ensure compliance with biosafety requirements, standard precautions, and biomedical waste management as per institutional and regulatory norms. 3) Data Management, Documentation, and Reporting Ensure accurate and timely completion of all project documentation. Maintain all registers/logs for specimen receipt, processing, testing, and storage. Ensure data entry systems (registers and/or electronic platforms) are used consistently, and that records are complete and auditable. Ensure test reports are generated and shared in a timely manner through the appropriate platform(s) and with authorized stakeholders as per reporting workflows. Ensure data confidentiality, ethical compliance, and adherence to project data protection requirements. 4) Team Supervision, Capacity Building, and Performance Management Conduct on-the-job training for the lab technicians Provide day-to-day supervision and mentorship to laboratory technician(s)/ assistant(s) and other supporting staff, ensuring role clarity and accountability. Plan staff rosters and ensure adequate coverage for peak workloads and continuity of operations. 5) Coordination, Stakeholder Engagement, and Communication Coordinate with clinicians and surveillance teams to ensure smooth enrolment and specimen flow, minimizing missed cases and improving completeness. Participate in review meetings; provide regular progress updates, including operational metrics (e.g., enrolment numbers, specimen volumes, positivity trends, TAT, data completeness, stock status, and key issues). Escalate critical issues (e.g., stock-outs, equipment failure, major delays, data discrepancies) promptly with a clear mitigation plan. 6) Inventory, Equipment, and Logistics Oversight Oversee inventory planning and ensure uninterrupted availability of consumables, reagents, kits, and PPE; prevent stock-outs through timely forecasting and requisitioning. Ensure equipment readiness, calibration/maintenance schedules (where applicable), and basic troubleshooting coordination with relevant teams/vendors. Ensure appropriate cold chain systems, storage capacity, and transport logistics are functional and monitored (e.g., temperature logs where required). 7) Project Timeliness and Troubleshooting Ensure laboratory activities are completed in accordance with project timelines and deliverables. Identify operational bottlenecks (laboratory, logistics, staffing, equipment, data flow) and implement corrective measures to restore performance. Perform any other project-related tasks as assigned by the Supervisor or Nodal Officer. Required Qualifications Master’s degree in Microbiology, Laboratory Sciences, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in diagnostic laboratory settings, including responsibility for supervision or coordination of laboratory operations. Strong understanding of microbiology/serology workflows and laboratory documentation practices. Experience in Public Health Labs or Management of projects is desirable. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality outputs under operational constraints. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and comfort with electronic data/reporting platforms. Skills and Competencies Strong communication, coordination, and supervisory skills. Proficiency in Marathi and English (reading, writing, speaking), Hindi. Willingness to travel locally as required for coordination, supervision, training, or operational troubleshooting. Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers highly dynamic and enabling work environment. Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates are encouraged to apply. Due to high volume of applications, only shortlisted applicants will receive a response from Jhpiego HR.

title: Program Officer/Senior Program Officer – Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC)- Lucknow
description: Overview Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health). CPHC will be responsible for leading key functions to support the implementation of Comprehensive Primary Health Care initiatives in Uttar Pradesh The role involves program management, monitoring and evaluation, stakeholder engagement, and strategic planning. The State Program Officer will work closely with government counterparts, donors, and other development partners to ensure the effective delivery of health services under Ayushman Bharat and other state health initiatives. Responsibilities Program Management: Oversee the planning, implementation, and operationalization of Health and Wellness Centers (HWCs). Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure alignment with program goals. Facilitate capacity-building initiatives for healthcare providers and program teams. Program Planning and Implementation: Develop and implement detailed work plans in coordination with state health authorities. Contribute to the development of state-level policies, strategies, and operational plans for CPHC. Support the integration of digital health initiatives, such as telemedicine (eSanjeevani), into primary healthcare delivery. Ensure the delivery of comprehensive health packages, including RMNCH+A, NCDs, and other essential health services. Program Monitoring and Reporting: Establish and operationalize monitoring and evaluation frameworks to track program performance. Conduct regular field visits to assess program implementation and identify areas for improvement. Use data to guide evidence-based decision-making and adaptive programming. Develop and submit high-quality programmatic reports, presentations, and briefs for internal and external stakeholders. Ensure accurate and timely documentation of program progress, challenges, and best practices. Maintain comprehensive records of program activities and achievements for audits and evaluations. Relationship Management: Build and sustain relationships with government counterparts and implementing partners. Coordinate with stakeholders to align program activities with state health priorities. Represent the program in meetings, workshops, and conferences at the state and national levels Required Qualifications MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS M.Sc Nursing or equivalent preferred with MPH or Post-graduation in Health Management. Up to 5 years’ experience with government public health programs, especially CPHC Preferred Qualifications Strong technical knowledge of NQAS, CPHC guidelines, IPHS, and national quality initiatives (LaQshya, MusQan, Kayakalp). Sound understanding of Ayushman Bharat, NHM structure, government systems, and key stakeholders. Proven ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage diverse program objectives. Strong data analysis, reporting, and documentation skills, with proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint and ability to meet tight timelines.

This initiative represents a mutually reinforcing approach to strengthening the education system, thereby linking improvements in the service delivery with strengthening health systems and the workforce. Given the scale and strategic importance of this initiative, there is a need to support the Health University for its operationalization to create a robust training ecosystem. The position will be responsible for providing support for developing an enabling Nursing education ecosystem for the state of Bihar. The position will report to the Program Officer – Policy, Patna. The purpose of this position is to support the Bihar University of Health Sciences, Bihar to streamline the Nursing education through strengthening the processes and examination system in nursing education/ trainings. This position aims to support the roll out Competency based Nursing education and examination by the Indian Nursing Council in the state of Bihar. Responsibilities Role and Responsibilities: Serve as the focal point for coordination with university leadership, faculty and other stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships with university officials and other stakeholders. Facilitate regular meetings, consultations, and communication between the university and Jhpiego. Support in the development and implementation of Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs), partnership agreements, and collaborative initiatives. Coordinate the planning and systematic roll out of the BSc Nursing curriculum in the state of Bihar. Support in developing detailed work plans, academic calendar, and implementation schedules for the University. Ensure timely delivery of project milestones and adherence to the program objectives. Support integration of program activities within the university’s system and academic structure. Organize workshops and training programs for faculty development in collaboration with the University. Coordinate logistics, resource persons, participant management, and training materials in collaboration with the University. Support curriculum enhancement and skill-building initiatives aligned with project goals. Track progress of activities against approved work plans and indicators. Maintain accurate records, databases, and documentation of program activities. Prepare periodic progress reports, meeting minutes, success stories, and presentations. Perform other activities, as assigned by the supervisor to achieve organizational goal. Required Qualifications Qualifications & Experience Masters’ degree in Nursing is preferable, Public Health, Social Sciences, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Minimum 2 - 3 years of experience in program coordination, Nursing education, Nursing academic implementation, or development sector projects. Experience working with universities, Nursing institutions, government institutions, or healthcare organizations is preferred. Strong understanding of public health systems and the higher education landscape in India. Preferred Qualifications Skills and Competencies Strong technical understanding of Nursing Education, Health University system, and nursing education reforms. Effective stakeholder engagement, communication, and project management skills. Strong planning, coordination, and organizational abilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi. Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently. Strong documentation and presentation skills.

title: Finance and Administration Manager
description: Overview The Finance and Administration Manager is responsible for providing financial and management support to the Jhpiego Uganda Office and related programs to ensure the efficient operations of the Uganda office This includes supervising day-to-day financial operations of the office, budgeting, and review of internal control systems, review of on-site financial accounting and bookkeeping system required to ensure the integrity and effective performance of Jhpiego’s financial operations. He/she will serve as a strategic financial adviser to senior management and project leadership, translating financial, budgetary, compliance and risk information into practical recommendations that support sound organisational and programme decision-making. The Finance & Administration Manager is also responsible for managing the operations and administration functions. This role will manage a team of finance and operations staff. Responsibilities Financial Management Monitors disbursement of funds from the project bank account(s) to ensure compliance with Jhpiego’s financial policies and procedures as outlined in the Jhpiego Finance and Accounting policies manual for country offices, Banking Policy, QuickBooks Manual, Procurement Manual, and any other policies Review payments of a higher threshold Review of QuickBooks monthly financial reports, conducts bank reconciliations and any other financial reports before submission to HQ Oversee the preparation of financial reports to donors like Department of State (DoS), CDC, and others as required Assists program managers to develop annual operational budgets for programs, review of budgets for accuracy, reasonability, completeness, and donor compliance Review and manage various financial monitoring tools like the purchase order log, airfare and airport transfers log, motor vehicle log, and other tools on a regular basis Ensure routine review and updates of quick books Review existing internal control systems to always ensure financial integrity; identify weaknesses and recommend corrective actions as per the GAAPs and Jhpiego’s financial procedures Budget Management & Financial Planning Lead the development, consolidation, monitoring and periodic review of organisational and project budgets, ensuring alignment with approved workplans, donor requirements and organisational priorities. Monitor budget performance and expenditure against approved budgets, proactively identifying variances, emerging financial risks, under/overspending and recommending timely corrective actions. Provide regular budget analysis, forecasts and financial insights to senior management and project leadership to support effective planning and decision-making. Coordinate budget reforecasting and budget realignments in collaboration with programme/project teams and ensure required approvals are obtained in accordance with donor and organisational requirements. Work closely with budget holders to strengthen financial accountability and ensure effective utilisation of available resources. Monitor project pipelines, funding availability and burn rates and advise management on potential funding gaps, cost pressures and financial sustainability risks. New Business Development & Proposal Budgeting Lead the financial and budget development components of new business proposals (SGP), including preparation of detailed proposal budgets, budget narratives, cost assumptions and supporting financial schedules. Work closely with technical, programme, HR and business development teams to develop realistic, competitive and compliant budgets for funding opportunities. Review solicitation and donor requirements to ensure proposed budgets comply with applicable cost principles, funding restrictions, indirect cost requirements and donor regulations. Develop and validate costing assumptions for staffing, operations, travel, procurement, administration and other programme costs, ensuring consistency between the technical proposal, staffing structure and proposed budget. Conduct financial modelling and scenario analysis to assess the affordability and sustainability of proposed programme designs. Support budget negotiations, clarifications and revisions during proposal review and award negotiations. Compliance & Financial Controls Ensure financial and administrative operations comply with organisational policies, donor requirements, applicable Ugandan laws and regulations, and contractual obligations. Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls to safeguard organisational and donor resources and ensure the accuracy, completeness and integrity of financial transactions and records. Conduct regular compliance reviews of financial processes and project expenditure and proactively address identified weaknesses or non-compliance. Ensure costs charged to projects are allowable, allocable, reasonable, adequately supported and consistent with approved budgets and donor requirements. Provide guidance to programme and operational teams on financial compliance requirements and promote consistent application of policies and procedures. Coordinate and support internal, external and donor audits, ensuring timely provision of documentation, responses to audit queries and implementation of agreed corrective actions. Risk Management Lead the identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of financial, operational and compliance risks across projects and organisational operations. Monitor emerging risks including funding gaps, budget overruns, fraud risks, procurement risks, partner/subrecipient risks and donor compliance risks, and escalate significant issues to senior management and/or to the compliance director. Track implementation of audit, compliance and risk-management recommendations and ensure identified control weaknesses are addressed within agreed timelines. Administration & Operations Office Management: Provide oversight on office management policies, procedures, processes and systems to ensure optimal support in the Uganda office. Provide regular feedback and resolution of office management issues. Administration support: Supervise and support the Administration officer in her roles Information Technology: Supervise the IT Officer to ensure IT requirements are met for both staff and program needs. Safety and Security: Work with the Safety and Security focal person to ensure regular updates and training are provided to staff, telephone tree and emergency contact information is available and overall preparedness for the Uganda office. Travel and Transport Systems: Ensure proper utilization of vehicle fleet, fair allocation of transport and tracking of vehicle use Required Qualifications Required qualifications: Master’s degree in business studies, Finance, Accounting, CPA qualification is required Required Skills and Experience Minimum of 5 years managerial experience 8 years of financial or cost management experience, in support of international development program operations Minimum of seven (7) years practical experience in QuickBooks accounting package Previous supervisory experience is required Experience with international, non-profit organizations with multiple donor funding mechanisms Experience working on U.S Government and /or CDC projects preferred Experience with financial analysis, financial reporting, cash flow analysis, budget development, and forecasting In depth knowledge financial software applications, databases, spreadsheets, and/or word processing required. Packages include Microsoft Outlook, Access, Excel, and Word. Basic knowledge of US government cost principles, GAAP accounting rules, and grant/contract management Strong problem-solving skills Excellent oral and written communication skills Demonstrated ability to effectively manage several major activities simultaneously Preferred Qualifications Deadline for applications is Friday 28th August. title: Especialista de Nutrición
description: Overview 1 plaza vacante en Alta Verapaz Visión General En Jhpiego trabajamos para salvar vidas, mejorar la salud y transformar el futuro de mujeres y niños alrededor del mundo. Trabajamos con gobiernos y organizaciones de base comunitaria para fortalecer los sistemas de salud que permitan a los países prevenir, detectar y responder a las amenazas de salud pública. Luchamos por mejorar el acceso a los servicios de alta calidad que las madres, los y las recién nacidos y niños necesitan para una óptima salud y nutrición. Jhpiego está buscando candidatos calificados para el proyecto RISE en Guatemala, proyecto que apoya la prestación de servicios que salvan vidas en las áreas de Seguridad Sanitaria Global, Nutrición y Salud Materno-neonatal. Objetivo del puesto Garantizar la implementación de las actividades del componente de nutrición que salvan vidas en los servicios de salud cubiertos por el proyecto. Responsibilities Técnicas Implementar las actividades del componente de nutrición en los servicios de salud atendidos por el proyecto, asegurando que se realicen conforme a los lineamientos técnicos, normativos y operativos del MSPAS y del proyecto. Colaborar en la identificación de las necesidades de mentoría ( on-the-job training ) e implementar las estrategias desarrolladas por el proyecto en el componente de nutrición sobre prácticas adecuadas de alimentación en los niños pequeños, mujeres embarazadas y en período de lactancia. Formación de personal (on-the job-training) en temáticas para la prevención y detección oportuna de casos de desnutrición aguda y consejería con énfasis en lactancia materna, alimentación infantil, higiene, identificación de desnutrición aguda y signos de peligro . Participar en las actividades de monitoreo y evaluación de su componente, incluyendo la recolección de datos y de información clave para fortalecer la toma de decisiones y ajustar las estrategias que respondan a las necesidades de los servicios. Colaborar para que las actividades ejecutadas por socios locales sean realizadas bajo los lineamientos técnicos y operativos del proyecto. Colaborar en la preparación de informes técnicos. Otras atribuciones que le sean asignadas. Programáticas Desarrollar planificaciones mensuales de actividades que respondan efectivamente a las prioridades de cada servicio de salud. Informar a su supervisor de brechas en el cumplimiento de la programación de actividades, para que éstas sean reprogramadas. Articular acciones y mantener una relación eficaz y respetuosa con el MPSAS y todos los socios del proyecto. Colaborar localmente con otros socios implementadores del proyecto para la ejecución de actividades que salven vidas. Mantener una comunicación eficaz y respetuosa con todos los miembros del equipo, fomentando un entorno cordial y colaborativo. title: Administrative Specialist

title: Consultant to Update Integrated Vector Management (IVM) Training Modules and Materials
description: Overview Rwanda Ministry of Health (MoH) and Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC), through Malaria and Other Parasitic Diseases Division (MOPDD), recognize that sustaining malaria control gains and advancing toward malaria elimination require strengthened implementation of Integrated Vector Management (IVM). IVM is a comprehensive, evidence-based approach that combines vector control interventions, environmental management, community engagement, and multisectoral collaboration to reduce malaria transmission effectively. Existing training resources require updating and enhancement to align with current technical guidance, Rwanda Malaria Strategic Plan (NSP) 2027–2030, and adult learning principles, while ensuring the training content remains accessible and relevant to community audiences. To support the implementation of community-based IVM interventions, there is a need for standardized, user-friendly training materials adapted to the local context and that can effectively strengthen the capacity of Community Health Workers (CHWs), community leaders, local authorities, and other stakeholders involved in malaria prevention and vector control. Through RISE Malaria Project, Jhpiego, in partnership with Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC), seeks to engage a qualified consultant to review and update a comprehensive IVM training packages comprising the following components: Review and update the existing national IVM training manuals (facilitators and users) and communication materials An audio-visual training package in Kinyarwanda designed to facilitate community learning and engagement; and An illustrated IVM training booklet featuring illustrations, figures, and simplified technical content presented through user-friendly formats, including tables and visual aids, to support community training and supportive supervision. These materials will contribute to the delivery of standardized, high-quality community education on Integrated Vector Management in malaria hotspot areas, thereby strengthening community participation and supporting Rwanda's efforts toward malaria elimination 1. Objective of the Assignment The general objective of the assignment is to develop quality, standardized and easy to use IVM training materials to improve community knowledge and support effective implementation of malaria vector control interventions. Responsibilities Based on Rwanda Malaria Strategic Plan 2027–2030. Review existing national IVM guidelines, training manuals and communication materials. Develop a comprehensive IVM training curriculum and facilitators guide Write scripts for the audio-visual training module in Kinyarwanda Design and develop an illustrated IVM training booklet. Revise and finalize all materials for printing and dissemination 2. Expected deliverables Inception report : Detail work plan, Methodology, Timeline and outline of proposed training materials (5days) Draft IVM Training Module: Develop and submit the revised draft IVM Guidelines, including the IVM training manual, the facilitator's guide, and the participant training module (10 days). Audio- visual training Package in Kinyarwanda : Final script, Training videos produced (10 days) Illustrated IVM training Booklet : Key definitions of IVM, Malaria transmission and Mosquito life cycle, Mosquito breeding habits, Larval source management techniques, Environmental management practices, Protection measures, Role of community in vector control, Practical illustration, Photographs, diagrams, table and infographics (10 days) Final Implementation report : Final report with importing all feedback (10 days). 3. Duration and Location This assignment is expected to be completed within 45 working days from the date of contract signature. The consultant will be based in Kigali, Rwanda and work closely with RBC and Jhpiego -RISE Malaria, with possible remote work for consultations and document drafting. 4. Management and Reporting The consultant will be contracted by Jhpiego Rwanda and will report directly to the Jhpiego RISE Malaria Director, with oversight and technical input from the Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC)-Malaria and Other Parasitic Diseases Division. Required Qualifications Master’s degree or higher degree in Public Health, Medicine, Medical Entomology, Epidemiology, Environmental Health, Communication, Health Education, or a related discipline At least 10 years of demonstrated experience in malaria prevention, vector control or Integrated Vector Control Management Strong understanding of Rwanda’s malaria control policies, community health systems and vector control strategies. Demonstrated experience producing audio- visual education materials, including script writing and coordination of multimedia production. Proven experience developing training curricula, adult learning materials and Job aids. Demonstrated experience supporting Ministries of Health or other government institutions, international organizations, or development partners is an added advantage Application submission deadline: August 16th, 2026 Note: interested consultant shall sign, compile and submit the following as a single document: A detailed CV outlining relevant experience A cover letter expressing interest and availability A technical proposal with details A financial proposal in Rwandan Francs (RWF), clearly indicating the consultant’s proposed daily rate and the total professional fees for the entire assignment. Submission of all the above-required documents is mandatory. Failure to provide any of the required documents will result in disqualification. title: Program Officer – Simulations
description: Overview Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health). About the Program The NNMC project will support reform in nursing by working closely with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, nursing regulators, State Governments and other key stakeholders to facilitate coordinated action across departments and institutions for operationalization of priority activities. Through collaborative planning, co-creation, and consensus building, the project will support the design and implementation of innovative interventions, including competency-based reforms across pre-service education and in-service professional development. The project will also generate, document, and scale evidence-based learnings from priority states, enabling adaptation and replication of successful models through a nationally driven approach to strengthen nursing education, regulation, and workforce systems. About the Position The Program Officer – Simulations will provide technical and programmatic support for strengthening nursing competency through competency-based education and simulation-based learning initiatives. The role will support the establishment and operationalization of simulation centres, faculty capacity building, development of technical resources, and implementation of quality improvement initiatives. The incumbent will coordinate with key stakeholders, support programme implementation, monitoring, documentation, and reporting, and contribute to advancing nursing education reforms and competency development. The incumbent will report to the National Program Manager. Responsibilities Provide technical support to States in planning, establishing, and operationalizing Nursing Competency Centres (NCCs), including site planning, infrastructure requirements, space layouts, utility planning, and connectivity requirements for competency assessment operations. Support planning and implementation of Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) systems, including station design, equipment and mannequin requirements, consumable planning, audio-visual recording and monitoring systems, and assessment workflows. Assist in the development of staffing models, role definitions, and operational plans for NCCs, including engagement, training, and standardization of assessors, proctors, volunteers, and other personnel involved in competency assessments. Support States in understanding the design and implementation of competency-based assessment methodologies, including OSCE and Computer-Based Testing (CBT), assessment content development, scoring approaches, and quality assurance processes. Facilitate the establishment of Technical Advisory Groups (TAGs) and support governance mechanisms, stakeholder coordination, institutional partnerships, regulatory approvals, and operational oversight for NCC implementation. Support capacity-building initiatives for State government officials and partner institutions through structured knowledge transfer, technical mentoring, and implementation support to enable sustainable management of NCC operations. Assist in the development of indicative infrastructure, equipment, operational, and human resource cost estimates, including budgeting considerations for establishment and long-term functioning of NCCs. Coordinate with government departments, nursing councils, academic institutions, healthcare facilities, and development partners to support effective implementation of nursing competency initiatives and simulation-based learning programmes. Support preparation of technical documents, implementation plans, operational guidelines, training materials, reports, presentations, and other knowledge products related to Nursing Competency Centres and competency-based nursing education. Assist in programme planning, implementation, monitoring, documentation, reporting, and coordination to ensure timely achievement of project objectives and deliverables. Perform any other duties assigned by the supervisor. Required Qualifications Graduate in Nursing with Advanced degree in Nursing/Public Health Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 3- 5 years of experience working in Nursing ecosystem with experience in Nursing Competency Centres/Simulation Labs operations. Strong analytical, research, and writing skills, with proven experience in policy development. Ability to manage stakeholder relationships and navigate complex regulatory environments. Knowledge of international practices in simulation and skilling in Nursing will be desirable Preferred Qualifications Skills and Competencies Strong coordination and communication skills for engagement with government counterparts and development sector stakeholders. Excellent documentation, reporting, and data management capabilities. Demonstrated skills in problem-solving, operational planning, and multi-stakeholder engagement. Proficiency in MS Office and digital communication tools; familiarity with digital health tools is an added advantage. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with effective written and verbal communication skills in English, Hindi. Ability to work under tight deadlines, manage competing priorities, and adapt to evolving project needs. Proven capacity to build and maintain productive working relationships with government agencies, technical partners, and other stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse technical teams. Strong technical and project management skills relevant to the position. Flexibility to handle a wide range of tasks and willingness to travel up to 30% of the time.

title: Manager, Sponsorships & Brand Partnerships
description: Overview The Manager, Sponsorships & Brand Partnerships is a creative, relationship-driven fundraiser responsible for generating meaningful unrestricted revenue through corporate and brand partnerships and activations. This position identifies, cultivates, solicits, and stewards a portfolio of corporate and individual donors to advance Jhpiego’s mission and meet annual fundraising goals.The Manager leads all corporate fundraising, sponsorship, and brand activation efforts, securing unrestricted five- and six-figure gifts and partnerships in support of Jhpiego’s programs and signature events, including the Laughter is the Best Medicine Gala. The role builds and grows corporate engagement and philanthropy through sponsorships, cause-marketing campaigns, employee giving programs, and VIP donor experiences.This position partners closely with colleagues across GECO to align fundraising goals with marketing and communications priorities, ensuring that all partnerships deliver measurable impact and revenue growth. This is a highly collaborative, outward-facing role with significant visibility across the organization to shape a growing brand partnerships programs. Responsibilities Corporate Fundraising & Portfolio Management Manage a portfolio of unrestricted corporate and individual donors in the corporate sector. Lead solicitation strategy, set revenue targets, and ensure achievement of annual fundraising goals. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, partnerships, and sponsorships. Report on pipeline development, revenue progress, and ROI. Event Fundraising & Sponsorships Lead corporate fundraising strategy for Jhpiego’s Gala and other signature events (without managing event logistics). Secure and renew corporate sponsorships and underwriting support. Collaborate on major gift asks and corporate proposals. Develop compelling cases for support and partnership packages. Corporate Engagement & Donor Experiences Design and execute engagement strategies that strengthen relationships and drive unrestricted giving. Oversee employee engagement initiatives and VIP donor experiences. Develop follow-up and stewardship plans to ensure donor retention. Advisory Board & High-Profile Partnership Engagement Manage corporate fundraising relationships with Advisory Board members and celebrity advocates. Support board and committee fundraising initiatives and events. Coordinate cultivation and recognition activities with senior leadership. Proposal Development & Stewardship Draft and deliver corporate partnership proposals, agreements, and stewardship reports. Track donor engagement metrics and provide actionable insights. Ensure compliance with recognition commitments and donor intent. Collaboration & Team Support Foster collaboration across GECO to align fundraising, marketing, and communications goals. Contribute to shared revenue planning and donor engagement initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Marketing, Nonprofit Management, or a related field 5 –7 years in corporate partnerships, fundraising, or nonprofit engagement Proven record of cultivating and securing corporate support, CSRor brand partnerships. Experience managing corporate donor portfolios and securing five- and six-figure corporate gifts or sponsorships Advanced knowledge of corporate fundraising, CSR, sponsorships, and cause-marketing. Expertise in moves management, solicitation planning, and donor engagement strategy. Experience designing and managing corporate donor journeys, employee engagement programs, and high-level cultivation experiences. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; proven ability to engage corporate decision-makers. Strong data management and reporting skills; proficiency in donor CRMs (Raiser’s Edge preferred). Collaborative team player with strong organizational and analytical skills Ability to travel up to 20% domestically and internationally, including evenings/weekends for cultivation events Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in the related field.
